name: Nectar of the Green Man
summary: Gold-green nectar from the oldest oak in the Hollow. The drinker communes with the land around them, as Commune with Nature; afterwards a DC 15 Wisdom save, or for 8 hours the forest's voice crowds their mind: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

powers.name: Drink
powers.text: Bonus Action: drink it to commune with the land (Commune with Nature). Then a DC 15 Wisdom save, or Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for 8 hours.
